title: Native skip-transcoder MLP approximation fidelity
hypothesis: For the pinned SmolLM2-135M layer-8 MLP, the released 128x top-k skip-transcoder will reconstruct the original MLP output with held-out relative MSE <=0.10 and cosine >=0.95 while activating <=128 of 73,728 features; its serialized standalone payload cost will be reported against the native dense MLP.
physical_object: Pinned HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M layer-8 MLP plus its released skip-transcoder checkpoint.
mirror_coordinate: Native sparse latent activation vector (top-k 128); MA-533 evaluates whether this atom basis faithfully represents the original layer before adding any Mirror-view parameter.
logical_multiplicity: One MLP function expressed through sparse transcoder features; no multiplicity claim in this screen.
controls: Released transcoder skip + decoded sparse feature output
Truncated-SVD rank-128 projection fitted on development activations as a generic compression control

task.model_revision: resolved and recorded in source before evaluation
task.dataset: Salesforce/wikitext wikitext-2-raw-v1 train split streamed in fixed order; deterministic seed-selected 128-token windows; dataset script/config pinned via captured metadata.
primary_metrics: cosine similarity per token, then mean

development.selection_metric: single fixed checkpoint evaluation; no tuning or fresh-based selection
development.task_scope: Use 16 fixed-order seeded windows (2048 tokens) to fit the rank-128 linear control and 16 disjoint windows (2048 tokens) for evaluation; training split only.

fresh.access_condition: Open only if dev relative MSE <=0.10 and cosine >=0.95.

storage.serialization: safetensors raw checkpoint plus canonical JSON config and required adapter code; report incremental and standalone deployment bytes

success_gate: On each fresh seed, transcoder held-out relative MSE <=0.10 and mean token cosine >=0.95; report actual serialized bytes and latency. Passing establishes only this checkpoint/layer approximation, not Mirror benefit.
failure_gate: Development held-out relative MSE >0.10 or mean cosine <0.95; keep fresh sealed.
boundaries: Single released checkpoint, model and layer.
This screen establishes transcoder faithfulness only; it does not establish logical MLP multiplicity or Mirror-specific gains.
Test data must remain unopened until protocol and source commits are pushed.
CPU-constrained development uses 4,096 tokens; no broad generalization claim.
